task: Unify `codemie analytics` into a single always-costed command/output contract (dropping contradictory --export/--report-format/otel paths) and add report-JSON shape tests that fail on unpriced models, live per-model 'hi' smoke tests through the ai-run proxy, and a pricing.json vs /v1/llm_models reconciliation test.

key_reasoning.reason: Base L: the analytics CLI command (runAnalytics flag contract, exporter/formatter), the cost/report domain (cost-enricher, payload-builder, report types, report-generator, session-report used by BaseAgentAdapter exit hook), the OTEL source path, plus three test harnesses (integration report-shape, agent-project live smoke via agent-smoke helper, SSO catalog reconciliation via fetchCodeMieLlmModels). Bumped to XL because making unpricedModels a trustworthy signal means touching the shared pricing util (lookupPrice family/tier fallbacks).

Intent is clear but several design decisions are open: which output(s) survive (terminal summary, CSV, RootAnalytics vs ReportPayload JSON), the fate of `analytics otel`, whether family/tier fallback prices and zero-usage hadLog sessions count as 'unpriced', how tenant ids (dated, -vertex, openai., routers) map to pricing keys, and how 'build should break' applies when live tests sit outside `npm run ci`. The referenced report.json is 0 bytes.

Closest patterns exist (single buildPayload, AnalyticsSource seam, agent-smoke.ts, vscode-models.live.test.ts per-model loop, fetchCodeMieLlmModels), so base M. Bumped to L: AC enumerate error/variant cases (fail on unpriced models, per-model live runs, catalog mismatches) with no existing test template asserting ReportPayload cost fields or reconciliation. Also breaks the documented public contract in docs/ANALYTICS-REPORT.md, always-cost default may slow plain runs, and live tests depend on network/credentials. Consistent with project L example profile-provider-decoupling (TR L, CS XL).

Roughly 11-15 modified (analytics index.ts, exporter, formatter, payload-builder, report types, report-generator, session-report, cost-enricher, otel source/loader, pricing.ts, docs ANALYTICS-REPORT.md/COMMANDS.md, several existing unit tests and cli-misc-coverage test) plus 3-5 new test files/helpers (report-shape integration test, live per-model analytics smoke, reconciliation test) across src/cli/commands/analytics, src/utils, docs, tests/integration and tests/helpers.
